sentence: This project builds an imaging method that uses magnetic resonance imaging to measure tissue composition in a knee disease model.
This project runs a cancer center that brings cancer science and engineering together to tackle problems in diagnosing and treating cancer.
This project tests whether a cell adhesion molecule can rescue synapses and protect photoreceptors from degeneration in mouse and human retinas.
This project builds a method that uses deep learning on routine images to find molecular markers in glioma without a tissue biopsy.
This project tests whether vascular grafts made from stem cells and lined with pig endothelial cells work well in a porcine model.
This project helps diabetes researchers plan and understand genetic studies and keeps a registry of people with genetic forms of diabetes.
This project builds an automatic segmentation algorithm and tests whether it can predict changes in alcohol drinking or negative affect during adolescence.
This project studies how memory T cells last long-term and keep their identities, and how cytokines and a DNA binding protein help.
This project builds an AI-assisted system to identify and evaluate incidental thyroid nodules and reduce thyroid cancer overdiagnosis.
This project connects cell types, gene expression, circuit connectivity and neural activity in the mouse primary visual cortex and shares a free atlas.
This project compares ways to increase ultrasound use for children's abdominal pain in rural communities and studies what influences that use.
This project tests whether nanopore adaptive sampling can affordably sequence and tell apart pathogens carried by ticks and rodents, including in field tests.
This project studies whether a radioligand therapy can prime a T cell response when combined with immune checkpoint inhibition in advanced prostate cancer.
This project tests whether adjusting the Hippo pathway can treat Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease, using genetic models and repurposed inhibitors.
This project studies how Cryptococcus spores mature, germinate and infect the mammalian lung to cause disease.
This project gives cancer researchers help with data analysis through biostatistics and bioinformatics.
This project develops focused ultrasound treatments aimed at the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex, including an incisionless intravascular device, for brain disorders.
This project studies how the antioxidant response shapes translocation renal cell carcinoma, a kidney cancer, and whether it can be a treatment target.
This project builds a network to combine data from many sites and study how genes and the environment interact, using brain organoids.
